headline: FULA Network Hits 30 Nodes as DePIN Storage Demand Surges
subtitle: Functionland's steady node growth and privacy-first AI integration position it at the intersection of two of 2026's most consequential technology trends.
briefing:
Functionland's FULA network has reached 30 active nodes — up from 26 just weeks ago — a 15% gain that reflects accelerating community participation at a moment when decentralized storage is drawing serious attention. <cite index="2-3">In January 2026 alone, leading DePIN networks generated roughly $150 million in on-chain revenue from real customers for storage deals, compute jobs, and data services</cite> — a signal that the sector has moved well beyond speculation. <cite index="1-2">The combined market cap of leading DePIN coins now exceeds $30 billion</cite>, and <cite index="7-11">venture capital funds invested more than $740 million in DePIN projects during 2025</cite>, underscoring the structural conviction behind the space.

Functionland's FxFiles MCP integration, announced earlier this summer, looks increasingly well-timed against that backdrop. <cite index="18-3">MCP servers often request extensive permissions, introducing significant privacy and security concerns — including unnecessarily wide-ranging access to connected services</cite>. Functionland's design takes the opposite approach: an AI assistant is invited into a single designated folder, with read and write access but no delete permissions — a deliberate constraint that addresses what <cite index="24-7,24-8">industry analysts identify as a core MCP weakness: the protocol does not define a role-based access control model and treats authentication as optional rather than required</cite>.

<cite index="14-6">Functionland's roadmap targets Q2 2026 for migrating larger companies and organizations' data from traditional cloud to the Fula ecosystem</cite>. With node count climbing and community integrations accelerating, the key metric to watch in coming weeks is whether enterprise onboarding converts that infrastructure growth into measurable on-chain storage demand.
